z-m-05-05.title: Mangaki ama-marble ebhodini lama-marble?
z-m-05-05.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezintathu zokubala, nquma ukuthi iyiphi indlela elungile ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani sihlola impendulo ngenye indlela.
z-m-05-05.material:
Ibhodi lama-marble linemigqa engu-5 yezikhala, ngezikhala ezingu-6 emgqeni ngamunye (izikhala ezingu-30 sekukonke). Kodwa ama-marble awekho kuzo zonke izikhala, futhi kunezikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho. Izinombolo zama-marble emigqeni 1 kuya ku-5, ngokulandelana, ngu-6, 6, 5, 5, 5. Abangani abathathu bathole inani lama-marble.
U-Gaon: "5×6=30, ngakho kunama-marble angu-30."
U-Narae: "Kunezikhala ezingu-30 nezikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho, ngakho 30 kususwe 3 ngama-marble angu-27."
U-Daon: "Ngibale ama-marble emgqeni ngamunye bese ngiwengeza. 6+6+5+5+5=27 ama-marble."
z-m-05-05.thinking.1: Hlola izimo lapho indlela isebenza khona
z-m-05-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izindlela ezisitshela ukuthi mangaki ama-marble sekukonke.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.0: Uma kunezikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho, cabanga ukuthi inani lama-marble likhulu noma lincane kunenani lezikhala.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thola umehluko phakathi kwesamba sama-marble emgqeni ngamunye nenani lezikhala, 30, bese uqhathanisa nenani lezikhala ezingenalutho.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.a: Le yindlela yokubala ama-marble emgqeni ngamunye bese uwengeza.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.b: 5×6 yinani lezikhala. Ilingana nenani lama-marble kuphela uma isikhala ngasinye sinelilodwa. Leli bhodi linezikhala ezingenalutho.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.c: Le yindlela yokukhipha inani lezikhala ezingenalutho enanini lezikhala ukuthola inani lama-marble.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.explain: U-Narae ukhiphe izikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho ku-30 futhi wathola u-27, futhi u-Daon ubale umugqa ngomugqa futhi wengeza wathola u-27. U-30 ka-Gaon yinani elicabanga ukuthi kunebhola esikhaleni ngasinye.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.prompt: Yini odinga ukuyihlola kuqala ukuthola inani lama-marble ngendlela ka-Gaon?
z-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba umugqa owodwa webhodi lama-marble bese ubheka ukuthi isikhala esisodwa ne-marble eyodwa zibhanqwe kanjani.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.a: Ukuthi onke ama-marble anombala ofanayo yini
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.b: Noma yisiphi isimo, inani lama-marble lincike ekutheni isikhala ngasinye sinebhola yini.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.c: Ukuthi imigqa inenani elifanayo noma amanani ahlukile kuthinta ukuthi usisebenzisa kanjani isiphindaphindi, kodwa kumele uqale ubheke ukuthi kukhona yini izikhala ezingenalutho.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.d: Ukuthi isikhala ngasinye sinebhola elilodwa yini
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.d: Umphumela yinani lezikhala, ngakho okubalulekile ukuthi isikhala ngasinye sinebhola yini.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.explain: 5×6=30 yinani lezikhala. Uma kunebhola elilodwa esikhaleni ngasinye, kunama-marble angu-30 nawo. Uma kunezikhala ezingenalutho, kunama-marble ambalwa kangako.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.prompt: Khetha noma indlela ka-Narae noma indlela ka-Daon, bhala inqubo yokuthola inani lama-marble ngayo, futhi ubhale nokuthi ungahlola kanjani ukuthi impendulo ilungile yini usebenzisa indlela yomunye umngani.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala imiphumela yezindlela ezimbili eceleni komunye.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala emusheni owodwa ukuthi yini ethulisayo uma amanani amabili efana.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ukubala kwendlela oyikhethile kuyahambisana nenani langempela lama-marble, u-27?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma uhlola ngenye indlela, ingabe usho ukuthi uqhathanisa amanani amabili?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.0: Indlela ka-Narae ikhipha izikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho ku-30 izikhala. Uma ubala ama-marble emgqeni ngamunye bese uwengeza, njengo-Daon, uthola futhi u-27, ngakho kuyaqinisekisana.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.1: Ngithole 6+6+5+5+5=27 ngendlela ka-Daon. Uma ngikhipha izikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho ku-30 izikhala, kungu-27, ngakho ngingahlola ukuthi inani elifanayo liyaphuma.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.2: Indlela ka-Daon: 6+6+5+5+5=27. Ngendlela ka-Narae 30-3=27, okufanayo, ngakho iyimpendulo elungile.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.3: U-Narae: izikhala ezingu-30 kususwe izikhala ezingu-3 ezingenalutho kungu-27. Ukubala umugqa ngamunye nokwengeza njengo-Daon nakho kunikeza u-27, ngakho ziyavumelana.

z-m-05-06.title: Ukuphindaphinda kuhlala kwenza inombolo ibe likhulu kunangaphambili?
z-m-05-06.goal: Hlola isitatimende esithi 'ukuphindaphinda kwenza inombolo ibe likhulu kunasekuqaleni' ngezibonelo eziphikisayo, bese usho ukuthi sisebenza kuziphi izidlulisi.
z-m-05-06.material: U-Doyun uthe, "Uma uphindaphinda inombolo ngenye inombolo, ihlala iba likhulu kunenombolo yokuqala!" Lapha inombolo yokuqala a iyinombolo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-9, futhi isiphindaphindi b iyinombolo kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-9. Thola umphumela ngamaqiniso okuphindaphinda.
z-m-05-06.prereq.0: Azi amaqiniso okuphindaphinda nemiphumela no-0 no-1 (Ibanga 2)
z-m-05-06.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela enhle yokuhlola isitatimende sika-Doyun?
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ukuhlola kusukela lapho isiphindaphindi siyinombolo encane kakhulu.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.1: Phakamisa isiphindaphindi esisodwa ngesikhathi kusukela ku-0 bese ubhala ethebuleni ukuthi umphumela ushintsha kanjani.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.a: Shintsha isiphindaphindi bese ufuna imiphumela engakhuli
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.a: Le yindlela yokwazi ukuthi igama elithi 'njalo' lingaphulwa yisibonelo esisodwa, nokufuna amacala angase aliphule.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.b: 3×2, 4×5, no-6×3 konke kukhule, ngakho isitatimende silungile
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.b: Noma zonke izibonelo ezintathu zikhule, uzame kuphela amacala lapho isiphindaphindi singu-2 noma ngaphezulu. Zama nezinye izidlulisi.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.c: Ukuphindaphinda kwenza izinto zikhule, ngakho kulungile ngaphandle kokuhlola
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.c: Umuzwa wokuthi ukuphindaphinda kwenza izinto zikhule uyisiqagelo, hhayi umthetho. Awukwazi ukwazi ngaphambi kokuhlola.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.d: Khetha kuphela izindawo ethebuleni lokuphindaphinda lapho isiphindaphindi sikhulu
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.d: Uma ukhetha kuphela izinombolo ezinkulu, awukwazi ukubona amacala lapho isitatimende singaphuka. Qala ucabange ngokuphindaphinda ngezinhlobo zezinombolo ezingaphula isitatimende.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuhlola 'ihlala iba likhulu,' indlela eqondile kakhulu ukuthola nokuhlola amacala lapho ingase ingakhuli. Ukuhlola izinhlobo ezihlukile zezidlulisi kubaluleke kakhulu kunokuqoqa izibonelo eziningi ohlangothini olufanayo.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonelo ezingu-3 ezihlukene lapho isitatimende sika-Doyun singeyona iqiniso. (Umphumela akumele ube likhulu kunenombolo yokuqala a. Umphumela olingana nenombolo yokuqala nawo ubalwa njengo-'akukhulu'.)
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Thola imikhiqizo uma onokuphindaphinda engu-0 nalapho engu-1.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi into efanayo yenzeka yini uma ushintsha inombolo yokuqala.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.2: Umkhiqizo olingana nenombolo yokuqala nawo ufakiwe ku-'akukhulile'.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Inombolo yokuqala iyinombolo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Inombolo yokuqala kumele ibe yinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Isiphindaphindi iyinombolo kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Isiphindaphindi kumele sibe yinombolo kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Uma isiphindaphindi singu-0, umkhiqizo ungu-0, ngakho uyancipha, futhi uma singu-1, umkhiqizo ufana nenombolo yokuqala, ngakho awukhuli. Uma isiphindaphindi singu-2 noma ngaphezulu, umkhiqizo uyakhula uma inombolo yokuqala ingu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Chazela uDoyun, ngezibonelo, ukuthi uphindaphinda ngazinombolo ziphi uma isitatimende sakhe singeyona iqiniso.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha izibonelo ezimbili zakho bese ubhala umkhiqizo nenombolo yokuqala eceleni komunye.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isiphindaphindi siyini ezibonelweni ezimbili.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ezibonelweni zakho, uqhathanise ngqo umkhiqizo nenombolo yokuqala?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Uhlukanise ukuthi imiphumela ye-0 neye-1 ihlukile?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma uphindaphinda ngo-0, 5×0=0, ngakho uncipha kunenombolo yokuqala. Uma uphindaphinda ngo-1, 5×1=5, ngakho uhlala unjalo. Ngakho isitatimende esithi 'kuhlala kukhula' siphosile.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma isiphindaphindi singu-1, 7×1=7 ufana nenombolo yokuqala, ngakho awukhuli. Uma singu-0, uba ngu-0 futhi uyancipha.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.prompt: Uma inombolo yokuqala iyinombolo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-9, isiphindaphindi kumele sibe yinombolo enjani ukuze umkhiqizo uhlale ukhula kunenombolo yokuqala?
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.0: Thola imikhiqizo uma isiphindaphindi singu-1, 2 no-3, bese uqhathanisa ngamunye nenombolo yokuqala.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.1: Setha inombolo yokuqala ibe ngu-4 bese usebenzisa izindinganiso ezisuka ku-0 kuya ku-5 ukubona ukuthi umkhiqizo uguquka kanjani.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.a: Uma uphindaphinda ngo-1, umkhiqizo ufana nenombolo yokuqala. Ukufana akusiko 'ukukhula'.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.b: Izinombolo ezingesiyo u-0 zifaka no-1. Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma uphindaphinda ngo-1.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.c: Uma isiphindaphindi singu-2 noma ngaphezulu, umkhiqizo mkhulu noma ulingana nenombolo yokuqala eyengezwe enombolweni yokuqala, ngakho uhlala ukhula.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.d: Ukuphindaphinda ngo-3 nakho kuyakhulisa. Kunezinye izinombolo ngaphandle kwezinombolo ezihambisanayo kuphela.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.explain: Uma isiphindaphindi singu-2 noma ngaphezulu, umkhiqizo okungenani umphindo ka-2 wenombolo yokuqala, ngakho uma inombolo yokuqala ingu-1 noma ngaphezulu, uhlala ukhulu kunenombolo yokuqala. Izinombolo ezingezona ezihambisanayo, njengo-3, nazo zifakiwe.

z-m-05-01.title: Uthola luhlobo luni lwenombolo lapho izinombolo ezimbili ezingaqhubeki zihlangana?
z-m-05-01.goal: Qoqa izibonelo ukuze ucabange ukuthi isamba samakhadi angeqhubeki siyinombolo yohlobo luni, lungisa ukuthi ukholwa kangakanani umcabango wakho ngemva kokuzwa incazelo yokubhangqa, bese usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende esiphindiwe asisebenzi.
z-m-05-01.material: USeoa noHajun badlala umdlalo wamakhadi ezinombolo (izinombolo ezisuka ku-1 kuya ku-30). Inombolo eqhubekayo (even) yinombolo engashiyi lutho uma uyihlanganisa ngamabhangqa (2, 4, 6, ...), futhi inombolo engaqhubeki (odd) yinombolo eshiya enye uma uyihlanganisa ngamabhangqa (1, 3, 5, ...). Kulo mdlalo, 'isamba' yinani olithola ngokufaka ndawonye zonke izinombolo ezibhalwe emakhadini.
z-m-05-01.thinking.0: Yakha umcabango ngezibonelo ezimbalwa bese ulungisa ukuthi uwukholwa kangakanani
z-m-05-01.thinking.1: Lungisa isinqumo sakho ngemva kokuthola izibonelo ezintsha nencazelo
z-m-05-01.thinking.2: Yenza wena isibonelo esiphikisayo sesitatimende esiphindiwe
z-m-05-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi inombolo eqhubekayo ayishiyi lutho uma ihlanganiswa ngamabhangqa futhi engaqhubeki ishiya eyodwa (ibanga 2)
z-m-05-01.prereq.1: Ukufaka ndawonye izinombolo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30
z-m-05-01.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi olusha lwembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha umcabango wakho ngesamba samakhadi angeqhubeki.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa izamba ezivela ezibonelweni zibe eziqhubekayo nezingeqhubeki, bese uzihlela etafuleni.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dweba u-3 no-5 njengamachashazi bese uwabhangqa wena, ulandela incazelo kaHajun.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.info: USeoa utholile isamba samakhadi amabili angaqhubeki kathathu. Isamba sika-3 no-5 singu-8, isamba sika-7 no-9 singu-16, futhi isamba sika-1 no-11 singu-12.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucabanga ukuthi isamba samakhadi amabili angaqhubeki sizoba yinombolo yohlobo luni?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngezibonelo ezintathu, kufanelekile ukuya kuze kube umcabango othi 'kubonakala kuqhubeka.' Ukusho 'njalo,' udinga isizathu noma ukuhlola okwengeziwe.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zonke izikhathi ezintathu bekuqhubeka, ngakho singasho ukuthi njalo kuyaqhubeka
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izibonelo ezintathu ziyisikhonjo, kodwa aziqinisekisi wonke amacala. Ungahlola nangezinye izinombolo.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kubonakala kuqhubeka. Uma ngizama nezinye izinombolo ezingaqhubeki, ngingakholwa kakhulu

z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Izamba ngu-8, 16, no-12, ezihlukile, ngakho akukho mthetho ongashintshi

z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Sengeze izinombolo ezimbili ezingaqhubeki, ngakho isamba naso sizoba ngesingaqhubeki

z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma inani lamakhadi lishintsha, ucabanga ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ohlotsheni lwesamba?
z-m-05-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngamakhadi amabili, okuqhubekayo kuvele kaningi, futhi ngamakhadi amathathu, okungaqhubeki kuvele kaningi, ngakho umcabango wokuthi kuncike enanini lamakhadi uyafaneleka. Kusengumcabango nje.
